method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49498, Act No. 36 of 2020, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation or reprint number stated; latest amendment in the compilation table: Industrial Relations Legislation Amendment Act 2024 s 160 (No. 43 of 2024, in operation 31 January 2025), with the Petroleum Legislation Amendment Act 2024 Pt 5 Div 15 in operation 28 May 2026 (its ss 428-430 and 431(2) uncommenced); with the Work Health and Safety (General) Regulations 2022, compilation version 01-c0-00 current from 1 July 2026 (mrdoc 49725, retrieved 19 October 2026; last amendment SL 2026/94)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 5, 7, 8 (who is a worker, who conducts a business or undertaking, what is a workplace); ss 19(1), (2), (4), 20, 21 (the primary duty of care, the duty to others, accommodation, the duty of the person with management or control of the workplace and of fixtures); s 17 with regs 35, 36 (eliminate, then the hierarchy of control); ss 4A, 27, 28, 29 (officers' due diligence, my own duties, others at the workplace); ss 30, 30A, 31-33 (serious harm; industrial manslaughter $5 000 000 / $10 000 000 and 20 years; Category 1 $680 000 / $340 000 / $3 500 000; Category 2 $350 000 / $170 000 / $1 800 000; Category 3 $120 000 / $55 000 / $570 000); ss 35-39 with reg 699 (notifiable incident, serious injury or illness including the WA 10-day medical opinion, dangerous incident, notifying the regulator, the 5-year record, the incident site); s 47 (consultation); ss 84-86, 88 (my right to stop unsafe work, the representative's direction, continuity of engagement); ss 104-106, 108, 110, 112, 113, 115 (discriminatory conduct for a prohibited reason; $115 000 / $570 000; the Tribunal within 1 year); ss 267, 272, 273 (no civil action under the Act outside Part 6; no contracting out; no levy on workers)
seat: the worker (the security officer injured in the tower)
